# Issue

**Title:** ENH: export plot to vega editor

## Description

As per our offline discussions @ElDeveloper, this changeset attempts to add preliminary "Open in Vega Editor" functionality. [Vega](https://vega.github.io/vega/) is a visualization grammar, capable of rendering canvas and SVG plots in the browser, as well as spec support in tools like R (AFAIK).

[Sample QZV](https://view.qiime2.org/visualization/?type=html&src=https%3A%2F%2Fforum-qiime2-org.s3.dualstack.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2Foriginal%2F2X%2F9%2F98dba03123f8a2200631b4601b1fe594ea5db94a.qzv) based on QIIME 2 MP tutorial subsampled data.
